title: Russian Civilian Deaths Are Growing Rapidly as Ukraine Expands Its Air War
text: The higher tempo of Ukrainian strikes has fueled discontent among Russians, but it is far from clear that it will change the Kremlin’s calculus about the war.

title: Six Killed in Houthi Strikes on Red Sea Ship, Yemeni Government Says
text: The Yemeni government said the ship was carrying food supplies to a port on the Bab al-Mandab Strait while the Iran-backed Houthis accused Saudi Arabia of transporting weapons.
